# Prompt to Academy

> A book, and the cohort curriculum derived from it, teaching children to use AI productively and safely by first making them do the thing themselves — small and by hand — and only then letting them delegate it and check the result.

## Book

- [Prompt to Academy](https://alpibrusl.github.io/prompt-to-academy/book.html): The full manuscript, twelve chapters, teaching a generation to specify, to check, and to answer for work it did not build.

## The Builders cohort (ages 13-15)

- [Student handout](https://alpibrusl.github.io/prompt-to-academy/handout.html): For the child working through a facilitated cohort.
- [Facilitator guide](https://alpibrusl.github.io/prompt-to-academy/facilitator-guide.html): For a practitioner running a cohort, with notes and planted traps.
- [Family guide](https://alpibrusl.github.io/prompt-to-academy/family-guide.html): For one adult and one child running the whole thing at home, no cohort or fee required.
- [Self-paced handbook](https://alpibrusl.github.io/prompt-to-academy/self-paced-handbook.html): For a reader going through it alone, traps tucked behind a spoiler.
